messages:
kaya: Heads-up - CS reports a wave of SCIM 403s and SAML verify failures after a scheduled KMS grant cleanup and an upstream IdP JWKS rotate around 04:20 UTC.

leo: paste from provisioner: 
```
2026-06-02T04:21:10Z ERROR scim/provisioner.go:187 decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444455556666:key/ccddeeff tenant=mono-inc req=7a1b
```

nina: and from sso-proxy: 
```
2026-06-02T04:21:42Z WARN sso/oidc.go:102 introspect failed: 401 invalid_token - token_kid_missing tenant=mono-inc req=9c2d
```

infra-bot: scheduled job `kms-grant-prune` ran 2026-06-02T04:20:00Z. Grants pruned: 8.

sre-oncall: likely two concurrent failures: the grant-prune removed a grant the provisioner used, and the IdP rotated JWKS so our cached keys didn't match incoming tokens. Both caused auth + decrypt errors.

kaya: quick triage checklist: 1) verify which grants were removed (CloudTrail RevokeGrant), 2) re-create minimal scoped grant for svcacc:infra-scim-provisioner, 3) force JWKS refresh in sso-proxy and provisioner, 4) run scoped backfill for queued SCIM ops.

leo: re-created grant for svcacc:infra-scim-provisioner with decrypt-only constraint and restarted pods. Local decrypt test passed. Provisioner 200s resumed.

nina: forced JWKS refresh by hitting provider jwks_uri and clearing local cache; restarted sso-proxy canary. Introspects returned 200 for canary tenants.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra/provisioner v1.17.0 (commit d4e5f6) - 2026-06-02T04:28:03Z

sre-oncall: backfill plan: run `./tools/scim-rescue --tenant-multiselect affected --since 2026-06-02T04:00Z --rate-limit 5/s`. Start with high-priority tenants.

kaya: ran CloudTrail query and found one orphaned grant belonged to svcacc:legacy-onboard which shouldn't exist. Filing SEC ticket SEC-2026-112 for orphaned service account + stale grant.

leo: mitigation summary posted to CS: impacted tenants ~14, queued ops ~320, initial backfill stage completed 120 ops. Will update when finished.

nina: action items: 1) add guard to `kms-grant-prune` to skip grants tagged `in-use-by`, 2) change sso-proxy to refresh JWKS immediately on token_kid_missing (no exponential backoff on first 401), 3) add a post-rotation verification step that asserts at least one successful decrypt and one successful introspect per active tenant within 5m.

sre-oncall: created temporary pager suppression for `scim.decrypt.errors` while we backfill. Keep thread updated.

kaya: closing loop once scim-rescue completes and SEC ticket created. Filing a short blameless postmortem and updating the KMS/IdP rotation runbooks. :white_check_mark:
